HIDE_IOS_ASC_KEY_ID.note: Names the App Store Connect API key that signs and uploads the release build; without it the release command stops before it builds anything.

HIDE_IOS_ASC_ISSUER_ID.note: The team behind that key; xcodebuild and altool both send it with the key, so without it nothing is signed or uploaded.

HIDE_IOS_ASC_KEY_PATH.note: The key file on the build machine, outside the checkout; Apple's tools read it by path; the command checks its name, owner and mode and never opens, copies or passes its body.
